defects_identified.title: MissingMetric Exception Classification Defect
defects_identified.description: cvss4py.classes.MissingMetric was omitted from the expected validation exception tuple in runner R1, causing 13,126 official FIRST negative test cases to be caught by generic exception handling and misclassified as EXECUTION_ERROR rather than syntax rejection.

defects_identified.title: Corpus and Endpoint Eligibility Conflation Defect
defects_identified.description: Protocol R1 aggregated 461,444 valid score-producing vectors and 25,028 syntax test cases into a single primary numeric score endpoint (D = 486,472), and collapsed mutual syntax rejections into EXACT_SCORE_MATCH.

post_result_declarations.discovery_timing: Defects were discovered strictly AFTER observing full R1 execution results during adversarial audit Order 288.
post_result_declarations.zero_r2_observations: Zero records have been evaluated under Protocol R2; no R2 outcomes exist.
post_result_declarations.formal_versioning: Protocol modifications are recorded as a versioned change (R6.2 / R2) under deviation R6-DEV-005.
post_result_declarations.historical_preservation: All R1 execution outputs and documentation remain unchanged and permanently preserved.

modifications.r2_protocol: Decoupled dual endpoints: Primary Numeric Score Concordance (D_numeric = 461,444) and Secondary Negative Validation Concordance (D_validation = 25,028)
modifications.impact: Eliminates contamination of numeric scoring accuracy by syntax rejection cases
